How should we conduct a comprehensive safety test on the car of the Spring Festival for 2020?Below I will use this 2015 Kaichen T70, which ran 822 kilometers to share with you.1. Check the air grid. If the dust is too dirty, it will cause the engine to be affected and pollute the oil, leading to an increase in fuel consumption.2. Check the oil ruler to observe whether the oil level of the oil is within the normal range, whether the color is darker, and if there is conditions, you can use the oil test paper to test the service life of the oil.I basically replace the oil for half a year or octal kilometers.3. The voltage of the battery is detected. The temperature in winter is low, and the battery is attenuation faster. Detecting brake oil. When the moisture content of the brake oil is more than 2.5%, it is recommended to replace it, or replace it every two years or 40,000 kilometers according to the standard.5. Check the whole car lights, such as headlights, fog lights, turning lights, brake lights.Especially the brake lights are very easy to ignore. If the brake light is not bright, it can easily cause rear -end accidents.6. Check the antifreeze. In winter, especially in the snowy area of ​​the north, when the temperature is low, if the freezing point of the antifreeze is not enough, it may cause the water tank to freeze.In the case of lack of antifreeze, you can add distilled water or anti -freezing fluid of the same brand to try not to add tap water.Under normal use, antifreeze can be replaced in three years or 60,000 kilometers.7. See whether there are loosening, whether there are oil seepage, or abnormal noise. For components that are susceptible to aging, they need to be replaced in time to ensure the safety of driving.9.
